---
title: "Stage 6 — Spatial prioritization"
output: html_document
params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "inspect"             # inspect | initialize | run | resume
  curve: "q50"                # q025 | q16 | q50 | q84 | q975
  max_stages: 100             # positive integer | Inf

  ecology_log_every_iterations: 10
                               # positive integer | null disables
  checkpoint_every_stages: 1  # positive integer | null disables
  checkpoint_keep: 2
  resume_stage: null          # null = latest retained checkpoint
---

```{r setup, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
# Stage 6 consumes the immutable Stage 4–5 spatial artifacts and either builds
# one shared prioritization initialization or runs the reverse-removal pipeline.
# default inspect mode is read-only and deliberately avoids loading large
# spatial objects or compiled kernels.
if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = FALSE)
}

source(file.path("R", "stage6_workflow.R"))

rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("6_spatial_prioritization_pipeline.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage6")
rmd_params <- configured$params
stage6_started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
active <- !identical(rmd_params$mode, "inspect")
context <- application_rmd_context(
  rmd_params, require_application = active, require_scenario = active
)
stage6 <- stage6_application_config(rmd_params, context, active)
describe_stage6_config(stage6)
```

## 1. Inspect, initialize, run, or resume

Each render performs exactly one operation. Shared initialization is separate
from prioritization so a long run starts in a fresh R session without retaining
initialization-construction objects.

```{r execute}
state <- NULL
if (stage6$mode %in% c("run", "resume")) {
  state <- read_application_state(context)
  validated <- application_reuse_boundary(
    state,
    application_scenario_shared_stages(),
    context$base_paths$root
  )
  assert(
    !is.null(validated),
    "Stage 6 execution requires a valid shared initialization. Run initialize first."
  )
  state <- validated
}

stage6_result <- switch(
  stage6$mode,
  inspect = inspect_stage6(stage6),
  initialize = build_stage6_initialization(stage6),
  run = run_stage6(stage6, initialization_record_validated = TRUE),
  resume = run_stage6(stage6, initialization_record_validated = TRUE)
)

if (identical(stage6$mode, "initialize")) {
  state <- application_commit_boundary(
    context,
    application_stage6_initialization_boundary(stage6, stage6_result)
  )
  application_finalize_scenario(context, state)
}
if (stage6$mode %in% c("run", "resume")) {
  boundary <- application_stage6_run_boundary(stage6, stage6_result)
  if (!is.null(boundary)) {
    state <- application_commit_boundary(context, boundary, state)
    application_mark_curve_complete(context, stage6$curve, state)
  }
}

if (identical(stage6$mode, "inspect")) {
  print(stage6_result$artifacts, row.names = FALSE)
  if (nrow(stage6_result$checkpoints)) {
    print(stage6_result$checkpoints, row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No retained checkpoints.\n")
  }
}
```

## 2. Final summary

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
cat("\nStage 6 summary\n")
cat("===============\n")
cat("Mode: ", stage6$mode, "\n", sep = "")
cat(
  "Curve: ", stage6$curve,
  " | Taxa: ", stage6$taxa,
  " | SDM: ", stage6$sdm, "\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat("Shared initialization: ", stage6$paths$initialization_bundle, "\n", sep = "")

if (identical(stage6$mode, "initialize")) {
  cat("Species: ", stage6_result$retained_species, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Patches: ", stage6_result$patch_count, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Population units: ", stage6_result$pu_count, "\n", sep = "")
}

if (stage6$mode %in% c("run", "resume")) {
  result <- stage6_result$priority_pipeline_result
  cat("Run directory: ", stage6_result$pipeline_output_dir, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Completed stages: ", result$completed_stages, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Removal events: ", result$removal_events_path, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Removal raster: ", result$removal_order_path, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Rank map: ", result$rankmap_path, "\n", sep = "")
}
if (stage6$mode %in% c("initialize", "run", "resume")) {
  cat("Runtime log: ", stage6_result$runtime_log_path, "\n", sep = "")
}

cat(
  "Elapsed: ",
  sprintf("%.1f seconds", proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - stage6_started),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
